proof_body:
by
  intro c s t hc
  have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc s t, HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.arctan (x / c) / c) (1 / (x ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) x := by
    intro x _
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y / c) (1 / c) x := (hasDerivAt_id' x).div_const c
    refine (h.arctan.div_const c).congr_deriv ?_
    have : x ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
  have hi : Continuous fun x : ℝ => 1 / (x ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    refine continuous_const.div (by fun_prop) fun x => ?_
    positivity
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF (hi.intervalIntegrable s t)]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (c s t : ℝ), 0 < c → (∫ x in s..t, 1 / (x ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) = (Real.arctan (t / c) - Real.arctan (s / c)) / c
